title: artpipe worker manifest
description: Passed to `codex exec --output-schema` (or the equivalent --output-schema flag on codex_image.py's generate/edit); the worker's FINAL chat message must match this exactly, no prose around it, and `codex exec`'s own -o flag captures it — the worker does not choose where this is written. The daemon treats this as one input among several and re-validates the returned file independently with validate_sprite.py, which is authoritative over anything reported here — see AGENTS.md's 'Failure is reported, never disguised'.

id.description: Echoed verbatim from the job's own id — never invented.

out.description: Absolute path to the finished PNG, or null. A missing `out` with status "ok" is the worst outcome available to a worker — verify the file exists before writing "ok".

background_used.description: "transparent" or the hex key actually rendered, e.g. "#10e010".

attempts.description: 1 unless a genuine tool error or refusal forced ONE retry (never used to chase a better result — the worker does not run validate_sprite.py itself and has no mechanical-reject loop of its own; that judgment is entirely the daemon's, after the fact).

note.description: What changed from the prompt, or why it failed. A refusal's own words, never paraphrased.
